chart.description: Distribution of execution times for queries that completed successfully. (mean over 6h)
chart.name: Average execution time (s)

noDataOptions.noDataMessage: Currently, no data is available for this chart.

chart.programText:
A = data('query/execution_times', filter=filter('service', 'bigquery')).mean(by=['project_id']).mean(over='6h').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).min().publish(label='B')
C = (A).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='C')
D = (A).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='D')
E = (A).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='E')
F = (A).max().publish(label='F')
